title: Call of the Night: Paradise Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume sequel arc set between the final two chapters of Call of the Night (Otaku USA). Kou Yamori and detective Anko are asked by idol Amu Miyamoto to help her bandmate Mei, who has joined a religious cult called 'Paradise' in a secluded countryside village (AniList). The cult's ageless 'guru', Lady Ushio, appears to be a vampire, and members obsessed with youth and immortality call themselves 'offspring' (Otaku USA; AniList).
life_message: Promises of eternal youth can hide manipulation, and friends must look out for one another.
